what: Logo reveal: pieces of a mark fly in on arcs, lock on one hit and settle; a glint crosses it and returns; the wordmark tracks in
title: BRAND
intent: Introduce the brand with one strong lock and a clean end card
action: Pieces of the mark accelerate into place and lock (punch, flash, shock ring), recoil and settle; a glint crosses the mark and returns every 1.6 s; the wordmark tracks in from wide spacing; a tagline settles; dust drifts and the accent breathes while it holds
look: Minimal glow: charcoal, warm white, one red accent, bloom in halo mode (style atlas #8)
make_it_yours: Paste your logo's SVG path data into `MARK` (viewBox 0 0 100 100), one entry per piece that should fly. Give each piece its `pivot` (its own centre) so it spins on itself. Put the piece that must keep an exact brand colour on `layer: 'top'`.
craft_note: Pieces accelerate into the lock (`power2.in`) so the energy lands on the hit, then recoil and settle: nothing stops dead. If it reads too aggressive, shorten the arcs (`from`) before softening the curve.
